title: TDS Exemption on Dividends for IFSC Aircraft Leasing Units: Ek Zaroori Update
content:
# TDS Exemption on Dividends for IFSC Aircraft Leasing Units: Ek Zaroori Update

Ek important update hai! Government ne International Financial Services Centre (IFSC) mein aircraft leasing units ke beech dividend payments par Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) se exemption announce kiya hai. Yeh move undoubtedly business process ko simplify karega aur IFSCs mein aircraft leasing sector ko further boost dega.

Yahan kuch key points hain:

*   **Exemption Kya Hai?** Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne clarify kiya hai ki IFSC mein ek aircraft leasing unit se doosri aircraft leasing unit ko kiye gaye dividend payments par ab TDS nahi kaata jayega.
*   **Notification Details:** Yeh exemption **Notification No. 141/2026** ke through granted kiya gaya hai, jo **November 4, 2026** ko issue kiya gaya tha (S.O. 6016(E)).
*   **Effective Date:** Is notification ka effect retrospective hai. Yeh **April 1, 2026** se लागू माना जाएगा.
*   **Condition:** Is benefit ko avail karne ke liye, dividend receive karne wali unit (payee) ko Form No. 1(N) mein ek verified statement-cum-declaration furnish karna hoga. Is declaration mein payee ko confirm karna hoga ki woh ek eligible IFSC aircraft leasing unit hai aur unka dividend income applicable exemption ke liye qualify karta hai. Payer unit ko Form 1(N) receive hone ke baad hi dividend par tax deduct nahi karna hai.

Yeh कदम IFSC ecosystem ko strengthen karne aur ease of doing business ko badhane ki taraf ek positive step hai.
